# BudScan AI - Multi-Stage AI Botanical Cannabis Scanner & Sommelier Engine
> High-performance computer vision and multi-stage LLM analysis system for cannabis quality grading, mold detection, PGR identification, and terpene profiling.

## System Overview
BudScan AI is an open-source, web-based AI agent designed for real-time visual analysis of botanical specimens. Powered by Google Gemini 2.5 Flash and multi-stage prompt engineering, BudScan AI evaluates trichome density, pistil ambering, calyx structure, and potential contamination vectors (such as Botrytis cinerea mold or synthetic Plant Growth Regulators).

## Core Capabilities & Features
- **Multi-Stage AI Visual Pipeline**:
  - Stage 1: Botanical Feature Extraction (Trichome clarity, color, density, pistil structures)
  - Stage 2: Quality & Risk Assessment (PGR detection, mold/mildew identification, calyx tightness)
  - Stage 3: Sommelier Report Generation (Quality grade, confidence score, terpene profile, safety warnings)
- **Defensive Offline Simulation Engine**: Works fully offline or without API keys using pre-trained visual heuristics and specimen preset libraries.
- **Real-Time Canvas Reticle & Heatmaps**: Interactive WebGL/Canvas visualizer providing visual feedback and scan targeting.
- **Web Audio FX**: Auditory cues for scan initiation, feature extraction, and safety notifications.
- **Accessibility & AX Compliance**: Full WCAG 2.1 AA support, screen reader live regions, keyboard navigation hotkeys (Alt+S, Alt+F, Esc).

## Technical Architecture
- **Framework**: React 19, Vite, TypeScript, TailwindCSS v4
- **UI System**: Modern Glassmorphic Cyberpunk Tokens, Motion/Framer-motion, Lucide Icons, Sonner Toasts
- **AI Backend**: `@google/genai` (Gemini Flash model pipeline) with JSON schema validation
- **Deployment**: Netlify / Static Web Application with PWA support

## Quality Classification Categories
- **FIRE**: High-grade specimen with dense trichome coverage, clear calyxes, balanced amber pistils, and rich terpene signature.
- **SUSPECT**: Moderate quality with minor blemishes, light trichome degradation, or uncertain structural density requiring human verification.
- **MOLDY**: Contaminated specimen exhibiting white webbing, powdery mildew, or bud rot (Botrytis cinerea). Safety warning triggered.
- **PGR**: Synthetic Plant Growth Regulator indicators detected (excessive brown hair density, rock-hard unnatural shape, lack of trichomes, low aroma profile).

## Frequently Asked Questions
1. **Can I use BudScan AI without a Gemini API key?**
   Yes! BudScan AI features an intelligent built-in simulation mode and sample specimen gallery so anyone can test and experience full visual analysis.
2. **Is my camera feed recorded or sent to third-party servers?**
   No images are saved permanently or sent to external servers beyond direct client-side analysis requests sent directly from your browser to Google Gemini API (or processed locally in demo mode).
